# EAFIT and the Mayor's Office of Montería support 205 entrepreneurs in strengthening their businesses

**Since the beginning of this year, Montería (Córdoba) has been the site of an initiative aimed at strengthening its entrepreneurial ecosystem, thanks to a partnership between the Innovation Department and On.going , EAFIT's impact entrepreneurship center, in conjunction with the Montería City Hall. To date, 205 local entrepreneurs have benefited.**

**This program offers a virtual and in-person training path, with** _**masterclasses**_ **, inspirational talks, and specialized consulting, designed based on a diagnosis of the state of entrepreneurship in the region, with the aim of providing entrepreneurs with key tools.**

- EAFIT and the Mayor's Office of Montería Support 205 Entrepreneurs in Strengthening Their Businesses

![Imagen EAFIT and the Mayor's Office of Montería support 205 entrepreneurs in strengthening their businesses](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/d894d963-e86f-47a6-8b08-a462ee32df80/web/On-going-monteria.jpg?crop=yes&k=c&w=823&h=450&itok=LERQrIxT)

The initiative, which will run until the end of May, aims to lay a solid foundation for the continued development of entrepreneurship in the region. The image shows Andrés Bilbao, co-founder of Rappi, in one of the classes.

Montería, the capital of the department of Córdoba, has become a hotbed of entrepreneurship. Since the beginning of this year, the city has been home to an initiative that seeks to transform its local landscape by strengthening the entrepreneurial ecosystem. This effort is the result of a collaboration between EAFIT University's Innovation Department and On.going, the university's impact entrepreneurship center, along with the Montería City Hall, with the goal of providing entrepreneurs with key tools for the growth and sustainability of their businesses.

The program has already impacted 205 local entrepreneurs from various industries, who, throughout these months, have followed a training path both virtual and in person, where they have had access to _masterclasses_ with experts, inspirational talks and specialized consulting, in a comprehensive support model.

“We previously conducted a diagnostic study that allowed us to understand the situation in Montería. Based on that mapping, we created training programs via WhatsApp so that entrepreneurs could choose what they wanted to study according to their needs.

“In addition, we developed synchronous and asynchronous virtual education spaces, as well as face-to-face meetings, where we could talk with them, perceive the feelings they had and how the issue was in the city,” says Tomás Ríos Múnera, director of On.going.

One of the most innovative aspects of this initiative, as the executive points out, is the integration of technological tools that have facilitated access to high-quality content from anywhere. At the same time, the program not only focuses on technical training but also promotes a transformation in entrepreneurial mindset.

Through in-person sessions with experts, participants have strengthened their skills in business management, business model optimization, financing, leadership, and marketing strategies. All of this is aimed at making their ventures more competitive and sustainable.

“We hope this process lays the foundation for a new phase of entrepreneurial growth in Montería. We want to consolidate a more connected, efficient, and results-oriented ecosystem that facilitates the emergence and scaling of innovative and sustainable initiatives. We also aim to build capacity within both the institutional team and the ecosystem's stakeholders, so that this process can continue and evolve over time,” says Ana María López Martínez, Manager of Entrepreneurship and Competitiveness at the Montería Secretariat of Economic Development and Competitiveness.

#### Diagnose in order to act

The initial assessment allowed for a mapping of actors within the science, technology, innovation, and entrepreneurship ecosystem in Montería, identifying key areas of opportunity. “We found more than 2,100 entrepreneurs from different sectors. We were particularly struck by the fact that 77% are women, a figure that contrasts sharply with the national trend. We also identified more than 200 entities that support the ecosystem, something that wasn't as clear in Montería. And finally, we found that 60% of these ventures were only generating one job,” says Tomás Ríos.

The mapping showed a high concentration of startups in traditional and mass-consumption sectors, such as food and clothing, but also revealed growth opportunities in sectors with higher added value, such as agribusiness and technology. This is explained by Indy Bibiana Bedoya Botero, an external consultant and expert in public policy for science, technology, innovation, and entrepreneurship at EAFIT University.

“The analysis also revealed significant structural challenges, such as poor performance in critical pillars of the ecosystem, especially regarding financing and coordination among key actors. This diagnosis was crucial for designing a relevant and contextualized intervention plan that not only addressed the identified gaps but also activated and strengthened existing capacities in the territory, under a systemic and collective construction approach,” says Indy Bibiana.

Para Ana María López, este primer paso facilitó tener una visión clara de los actores, recursos, capacidades y brechas. Además, destaca el valor de contar con la Universidad como aliado: “EAFIT es reconocida en el ámbito nacional por su experiencia en el fortalecimiento de ecosistemas de innovación y emprendimiento, y por su capacidad para diseñar metodologías adaptadas al contexto local. Su enfoque académico riguroso, sumado a una visión práctica y territorial, fue clave para elegirla como aliada estratégica. Igualmente, compartimos con EAFIT la convicción de que la transformación de los territorios se logra con conocimiento, articulación y liderazgo”.

Una vez finalice el proceso el próximo 30 de mayo, se espera implementar acciones concretas de dinamización y articulación del ecosistema, que continúen brindando herramientas a los emprendedores en cualquier etapa del ciclo de vida de sus negocios. Asimismo, se busca fortalecer las alianzas público-privadas y con la academia para asegurar la sostenibilidad y su integración con las apuestas regionales de competitividad e innovación.

###### Virus contra bacterias, la propuesta para el sector porcino de PhageLife desde EAFIT

En una granja porcina, una infección bacteriana puede poner en riesgo la salud de los animales y la productividad del negocio. Además, el problema se vuelve más complejo cuando las bacterias dejan de responder a los antibióticos que antes permitían combatirlas. Para explorar otra vía, la empresa [PhageLife](https://phagelife.co/) desarrolla soluciones personalizadas con bacteriófagos, virus naturales capaces de eliminar bacterias específicas.
